ClearCompany pricing starts at roughly $60 per user per month for its ATS-only module. The full talent management suite runs $7-$10 per employee per month, based on third-party estimates from [Paraform](https://www.paraform.com/blog/clearcompany-pricing-2025) (2025) and [OutSail](https://www.outsail.co/post/clearcompany-reviews---pricing-pros-cons-and-user-feedback) (2025). What's the catch? No pricing appears on its website. Every plan requires a custom sales quote, which makes comparison shopping difficult.

Beyond the missing numbers, the platform isn't cheap. [SelectHub](https://www.selecthub.com/p/talent-management-system/clearcompany/) rates ClearCompany at its maximum price tier (5 out of 5 dollar signs), putting it among the most expensive platforms in the talent management category. And verified buyer reviews on [Capterra](https://www.capterra.com/p/45188/ClearCompany/reviews/) flag a pattern of undisclosed add-on fees, expensive data migrations, and mid-contract price increases.

This guide breaks down ClearCompany's module structure, maps out costs from buyer-reported data, and compares it to five alternatives. You'll know exactly what to budget before you get on a sales call.

> **TL;DR:**
>
> - **Recruiting modules run ~$60-$80/user/mo.** ATS-only around $60/user, advanced modules ~$80/user, per third-party data from [Paraform](https://www.paraform.com/blog/clearcompany-pricing-2025) and [OutSail](https://www.outsail.co/post/clearcompany-reviews---pricing-pros-cons-and-user-feedback).
> - **Full suite adds per-employee pricing.** Performance, engagement, and learning modules run $7-$10 per employee per month, so your bill scales with total headcount, not just HR seats.
> - **Nothing is public.** ClearCompany's pricing page shows no dollar figures, and buyers report surprise add-on fees plus mid-contract price increases ([Capterra](https://www.capterra.com/p/45188/ClearCompany/reviews/)).
> - **No free tier or trial.** You sign an annual contract before testing, and implementation via ClearCare typically adds 6-8 weeks of professional services.
> - **A 100-employee company budgets $10K-$30K/year.** Actual cost depends on modules selected. For AI sourcing without opaque enterprise pricing, [Pin](https://www.pin.com/) starts at $100/mo with a free tier.

## How Much Does ClearCompany Cost in 2026?

No dollar figures appear on ClearCompany's [official pricing page](https://www.clearcompany.com/pricing/), only a list of modules and features. To get any numbers, you'll need to request a demo and work through a sales process. That said, multiple third-party sources have aggregated buyer-reported pricing that gives a reliable picture.

Based on verified data, here's what companies actually pay:

<figure style="margin:2rem 0;padding:0;line-height:0"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="ClearCompany Estimated Costs (2026)" style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border-radius:12px"></figure>

What matters most about ClearCompany's pricing model:

-   **Two pricing dimensions.** The ATS and recruiting modules use per-user pricing (your HR team's seats). Performance management, engagement, and learning modules use per-employee pricing (total headcount). Buying both means paying on both axes.
-   **Annual billing required.** Month-to-month plans aren't available at lower tiers. Expect to sign an annual contract at minimum.
-   **No free tier or trial.** According to [Capterra](https://www.capterra.com/p/45188/ClearCompany/pricing/) (2026), ClearCompany doesn't offer a free plan or trial period. You commit before you test.
-   **Implementation adds 6-8 weeks.** Professional services through ClearCare (implementation, data migration, compliance) cost extra and aren't included in base pricing.

Dual pricing creates a compounding cost problem. A 200-employee company with a 5-person HR team could pay $300-$400/month for recruiting seats plus $1,400-$2,000/month for full-suite employee access. Annual costs reach $20,400-$28,800 before add-ons, and that number grows automatically as you hire more people. Scaling companies should model ClearCompany costs at 150% of current headcount before signing.

**What recruiters tell us:** Recruiters who switch to Pin after evaluating ClearCompany typically flag the same friction: weeks in a sales cycle, a contract with undisclosed add-on fees, and no ability to test with real data before committing. According to Pin's 2026 user survey, 91% of users reduced or eliminated spend on their previous recruiting platform after switching to Pin, and 90% saw a reduction in overall recruiting spend. The pattern is clearest for agencies: ClearCompany's per-user plus per-employee pricing model compounds in ways that aren't obvious until the invoice arrives. A 5-person recruiting team at a 200-person company ends up paying two pricing layers, and neither one discounts the other.

## What Does Each ClearCompany Module Include?

Rather than traditional pricing tiers, ClearCompany organizes its platform into lifecycle stages. Each module can be purchased separately or bundled into the TotalTalent suite. Here's the breakdown based on ClearCompany's [pricing page](https://www.clearcompany.com/pricing/) (2026):

| Module | What's Included | Pricing Model | Ideal For |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <strong>ClearRecruit</strong> | ATS, candidate attraction, background checks, onboarding | Per user/month | Teams that only need hiring |
| <strong>ClearTalent</strong> | Goals, alignment, talent reviews (adds to ClearRecruit) | Per employee/month | Teams adding performance goals |
| <strong>ClearGrow</strong> | Performance management, engagement surveys, learning, compensation | Per employee/month | Full-cycle HR departments |
| <strong>ClearLearn</strong> | LMS powered by Brainier (acquired June 2024), SCORM courses, AI course builder | Per employee/month | Companies with training requirements |
| <strong>TotalTalent</strong> | All modules bundled end-to-end | Blended (per user + per employee) | Mid-market companies wanting one platform |
| <strong>ClearCare</strong> (add-on) | Implementation, talent coaching, concierge support, IT integration, compliance | Project-based or retainer | Companies needing hands-on setup |

Modular pricing sounds flexible, but it creates a few issues. You can start with just ClearRecruit for hiring, which keeps costs lower. But the moment you add performance management or engagement surveys, your pricing model shifts from per-user to per-employee - and your bill scales with total headcount rather than just HR seats.

In 2025, ClearCompany also launched several AI features: an AI Sourcing Engine, AI Talent Match, and an AI Notetaker. These are bundled under the Talent AI Suite, though public information doesn't make clear whether they're included at every tier or treated as paid add-ons. Ask your sales rep explicitly.

Teams evaluating applicant tracking systems specifically will find our [guide to the best ATS platforms in 2026](https://www.pin.com/blog/best-applicant-tracking-systems/) covers 12 options across every budget range.

## What Hidden Costs Do ClearCompany Buyers Report?

Hidden fees are where ClearCompany's real cost lives. Verified buyer reviews on [Capterra](https://www.capterra.com/p/45188/ClearCompany/reviews/) and [GetApp](https://www.getapp.com/hr-employee-management-software/a/clearcompany/pricing/) flag a consistent pattern of charges that stay invisible until after you sign a contract: additional seats, data migration, API access, and mid-contract increases. Here are the most commonly reported:

-   **Additional user seats.** Adding new HR team members to the platform costs extra. One buyer wrote: "Nickel and dime for every extra item. Additional user seats are expensive" ([Capterra](https://www.capterra.com/p/45188/ClearCompany/reviews/), 2024).
-   **Data migration.** Moving your existing candidate data from a previous ATS into ClearCompany carries a separate fee. The same reviewer noted: "Data migration from previous ATS is expensive."
-   **API access.** If your team needs to connect ClearCompany with other tools through its API, that's behind a paywall - not included in standard plans.
-   **Undisclosed add-ons.** A CEO left a 1-star review on Capterra citing "unethical business practices on trying to do add on costs without disclosing in the contract."
-   **Post-acquisition price increases.** ClearCompany was acquired by Gemspring Capital (private equity) in September 2023. One GetApp reviewer reported the company "wanted to double our cost" after a platform transition. PE-backed companies often increase prices to improve margins - worth factoring into long-term budget planning.

For pricing negotiations, the Gemspring Capital acquisition is a material detail. Private equity firms typically target 20-30% EBITDA improvement within 3-5 years of acquisition, which often translates to price increases, reduced discounting, and new premium tiers. Signing a ClearCompany contract in 2026? Negotiate price caps for renewals, and get add-on pricing in writing before you commit.

Pin takes a different approach to pricing transparency. All plans are published at pin.com - $100/mo for Starter, $149/mo for Professional, $249/mo for Business - with a free tier that requires no credit card. As Rich Rosen, Executive Recruiter at Cornerstone Search, puts it: "Absolutely money maker for Recruiters... in 6 months I can directly attribute over $250K in revenue to Pin."

## What Does ClearCompany Implementation Actually Cost?

Plan to add 15-25% to your Year 1 bill for implementation, which typically runs 6-8 weeks before you go live. None of those professional services sit inside the base subscription. ClearCare, the company's professional services arm, offers several packages at additional cost:

-   **Standard implementation.** Includes account setup, core module configuration, user training, and basic integrations. This is typically bundled into the first contract but quoted separately - so it inflates your Year 1 costs compared to the ongoing subscription.
-   **Data migration.** Moving candidate records, employee data, and historical information from your existing ATS or HRIS is a separate fee. Multiple [Capterra](https://www.capterra.com/p/45188/ClearCompany/reviews/) reviewers (2024) flagged this as unexpectedly expensive.
-   **Custom integrations.** Connecting ClearCompany to your existing HRIS, payroll system, or background check provider may require paid IT integration services. API access itself sits behind a paywall on lower tiers.
-   **Talent coaching and concierge.** Ongoing support packages for teams that want hands-on guidance beyond standard customer support.
-   **Compliance services.** Dedicated support for companies with specific regulatory requirements.

To estimate your real Year 1 cost, add 15-25% on top of the annual subscription for implementation and migration. A company paying $20,000/year in subscription fees should budget $23,000-$25,000 for the first year. That overhead drops in Year 2, but renewal pricing may increase - especially under the current private equity ownership.

## Who Is ClearCompany Built For?

Mid-market companies with 100-500 employees are ClearCompany's core market, specifically teams that want one platform covering hiring, onboarding, performance management, and learning. According to [6sense](https://6sense.com/tech/recruitment/clearcompany-market-share) (2026), the largest customer segment has 100-249 employees, and 92.6% of ClearCompany's customer base is in the United States.

Founded in 2004 in Boston, ClearCompany has been around longer than most HR tech platforms. The company was acquired by [Gemspring Capital](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/gemspring-capital-acquires-clearcompany-301932802.html) in September 2023 and acquired Brainier (an enterprise LMS) in June 2024 - signaling a push toward full talent management suite coverage. With 2,000+ customers and a spot on the Inc. 5000 list for 10 consecutive years, it's an established product with a track record.

Verified by 503 users on [G2](https://www.g2.com/products/clearcompany/reviews) (2026), the platform earned a 4.6/5 rating. [Brandon Hall Group](https://brandonhall.com/hrs-best-kept-secret-and-biggest-opportunity-clearcompanys-quiet-revolution-in-hr-tech/) described ClearCompany as "profitable, self-sustaining" with "consistent 30% growth" - an unusual profile for a company that doesn't dominate headlines. The positive reviews focus on the unified platform experience: one login for hiring, onboarding, goals, performance, and learning.

That said, ClearCompany works best for teams that actually need the full suite. Buy just the ATS module, and you're paying per-user rates that aren't competitive with dedicated ATS tools. Bundling recruiting, performance management, and learning together improves the value proposition, though it also means higher total costs and more organizational buy-in.

ClearCompany isn't a strong fit if:

-   **You're a recruiting agency.** The platform is designed for in-house HR teams, not multi-client agency workflows.
-   **You need AI-powered sourcing.** ClearCompany's AI features launched in 2025 and are still maturing. Dedicated sourcing tools search larger databases with more precision.
-   **You want transparent pricing.** If "request a demo" pricing feels like a red flag, platforms with published rates will save you time.
-   **You're a small team under 50 employees.** The per-user costs don't scale down well for small HR departments.
-   **You're primarily outside the US.** With 92.6% of customers in the United States, ClearCompany's ecosystem is heavily US-focused. Global teams may find gaps in compliance support and localization.

Teams focused on candidate sourcing and outreach rather than complete HR management face a different comparison entirely. An [ATS vs. recruiting CRM breakdown](https://www.pin.com/blog/ats-vs-crm-recruiters/) can help you figure out which tool type actually matches your workflow.

## How to Negotiate ClearCompany Pricing

Since ClearCompany pricing is entirely custom-quoted, there's room to negotiate. Here are specific tactics based on buyer-reported experiences and common enterprise software negotiation strategies:

-   **Start with one module.** Don't buy the TotalTalent bundle upfront. Begin with ClearRecruit (ATS only) and add modules later. Starting narrow gives you a lower initial commitment and real usage data to negotiate from when expanding.
-   **Get add-on pricing in writing.** Before signing, ask for a complete list of every potential add-on cost: additional user seats, API access, data migration, custom integrations, and ClearCare professional services. Pin these to specific dollar figures in your contract.
-   **Negotiate renewal caps.** After the Gemspring Capital acquisition, buyers report price increases. Include a renewal price cap (e.g., no more than 5-7% annual increases) in your initial agreement.
-   **Request a headcount buffer.** If your company is growing, negotiate a headcount range rather than a fixed number. A 20% buffer prevents mid-contract true-ups from triggering surprise bills.
-   **Ask about multi-year discounts.** Two or three-year commitments typically unlock 10-20% discounts on enterprise software. Just make sure the renewal cap is locked in too.
-   **Compare quotes openly.** Tell your ClearCompany rep exactly what Greenhouse, BambooHR, or Workable quoted you. Competition-aware pricing gets you better terms than accepting the first offer.

One final tip: don't rush the sales process. ClearCompany's implementation takes 6-8 weeks regardless of when you sign. Taking an extra week to negotiate properly could save thousands over the contract term.

Most buyers miss this negotiation angle: ClearCompany's fiscal calendar works in your favor. End-of-quarter and end-of-year conversations tend to produce better discounts because sales teams are trying to hit targets. If your evaluation timeline is flexible, time your final negotiation to land in the last two weeks of a quarter. Competing quotes from Greenhouse, BambooHR, or Workable add negotiating power - ClearCompany reps have pre-approved discount tiers for those competitive situations.

## How to Model Your Total ClearCompany Cost

Because ClearCompany pricing depends on so many variables, running a quick cost model before your sales call helps you negotiate from a stronger position. This cost-modeling framework works for most teams:

### Step 1: Count Your Users and Employees Separately

Two axes drive the bill. Your "users" are HR team members who log into the platform (recruiters, HR managers, talent leads). Your "employees" are total headcount for modules like performance management, engagement, and learning. A 200-employee company with a 4-person HR team has different cost exposure than a 200-employee company with a 10-person HR team.

### Step 2: Pick Your Modules

Start by listing which modules you actually need. ClearRecruit only? That's per-user pricing. Adding ClearGrow for performance management? Now you're paying per-employee too. The TotalTalent bundle may offer a discount over buying modules individually, but it locks you into the full suite.

### Step 3: Model Growth Scenarios

Run your cost estimate at your current headcount, then at 125% and 150%. If you're a 150-employee company expecting to hit 225 in 18 months, you need to know what your contract looks like at that size. Per-employee modules scale automatically with headcount - your bill grows every time you hire someone.

### Step 4: Add Implementation and Migration

Budget 15-25% on top of Year 1 subscription costs for implementation. If you're migrating from an existing ATS, get a written quote for data migration before signing. Several buyers reported this was one of the most expensive surprise costs.

### Quick Example

A 200-employee company with 5 HR users buying ClearRecruit + ClearGrow:

-   ClearRecruit: 5 users x $60/mo = $300/mo ($3,600/yr)
-   ClearGrow: 200 employees x ~$8/mo = $1,600/mo ($19,200/yr)
-   Subtotal: $22,800/yr
-   Implementation (20%): $4,560
-   Year 1 total: ~$27,360
-   Year 2 total (subscription only): ~$22,800 (before any renewal increases)

That's a significant investment. Pin's Business plan at $249/mo, by comparison, covers AI sourcing, outreach, and scheduling for $2,988/yr - roughly 10% of the ClearCompany cost above. Different tools, different scopes, but worth considering whether you need a full HR suite or a focused recruiting workflow.

Good for companies focused on relationship-based hiring, but limited on the performance management side compared to ClearCompany. Lever's CRM capabilities give it an edge over pure ATS tools for teams building long-term talent pipelines.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does ClearCompany cost per month?

ClearCompany doesn't publish pricing, but third-party estimates put the ATS module at ~$60/user/month and the full suite at $7-$10/employee/month ([Paraform](https://www.paraform.com/blog/clearcompany-pricing-2025), 2025). For a 100-employee company, expect $10,000-$30,000/year depending on which modules you select. All pricing requires a custom quote from their sales team.

### Does ClearCompany offer a free trial?

No. ClearCompany doesn't offer a free trial or free tier according to [Capterra](https://www.capterra.com/p/45188/ClearCompany/pricing/) (2026). You'll need to go through a demo process and commit to a paid annual contract before accessing the platform. There's no sandbox environment to test with your own data. For comparison, platforms like Pin and Workable both offer free tiers that let you test the product with real workflows before committing any budget.

### Is ClearCompany cheaper than Greenhouse?

It depends on what you're buying. ClearCompany's ATS-only module can be cheaper than Greenhouse for small teams. But if you add performance management and learning modules, ClearCompany's total cost often exceeds Greenhouse's median $12,250/yr contract ([PriceLevel](https://www.pricelevel.com/vendors/greenhouse/pricing), 2025). Greenhouse is ATS-only; ClearCompany bundles more - and charges accordingly.

### What are the biggest complaints about ClearCompany pricing?

Buyer reviews on [Capterra](https://www.capterra.com/p/45188/ClearCompany/reviews/) consistently flag undisclosed add-on fees, expensive data migration, API access behind a paywall, and mid-contract price increases. One CEO described "unethical business practices on trying to do add on costs without disclosing in the contract." Get all add-on pricing in writing before signing.

### What is ClearCompany?

ClearCompany is a talent management platform founded in 2004 and acquired by Gemspring Capital in September 2023. Headquartered in Boston, the platform covers the full HR lifecycle: applicant tracking (ClearRecruit), onboarding, performance management (ClearGrow), employee learning (ClearLearn), and goal alignment (ClearTalent), bundled as the TotalTalent suite. According to [6sense](https://6sense.com/tech/recruitment/clearcompany-market-share) (2026), 92.6% of ClearCompany's 2,000+ customers are US-based companies, primarily in the 100-249 employee range. Unlike dedicated recruiting tools, ClearCompany focuses on in-house HR teams rather than staffing agencies, and does not publish pricing on its website.

It depends on what you're optimizing for. If your primary need is candidate sourcing and outreach rather than full HR management, Pin searches 850M+ profiles with AI-powered matching.
